description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity component in an Android project, responsible for displaying details about a selected media content, including fetching additional information from a remote API, loading images, and handling user interface interactions.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that displays detailed information about selected content, including loading images, fetching additional info from a server, and providing a user interface with a poster, title, description, and a 'Watch now' button.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, loads the poster image, and initiates fetching content info based on intent extras.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Performs a network request to fetch additional content details (title and description) from a specified API endpoint and updates the UI accordingly.
